{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now check the count of severe baseline disease
severe_count = df_dedup['severity'].eq('severe').sum()
total_patients = len(df_dedup)
fraction_severe = severe_count / total_patients

print(f"Deduplicated patients: {total_patients}")
print(f"Severe baseline: {severe_count}")
print(f"Fraction severe: {fraction_severe:.4f}")"}
